# Edwin Kibirai Isuzu Sales

> Premier authorized Isuzu dealership sales partner in Nairobi, Kenya. Specializing in brand-new, zero-mileage Isuzu commercial trucks (N-Series, F-Series), Isuzu D-Max pickups, mu-X 7-seater SUVs, passenger buses, and UD Quester heavy prime movers. Physical showroom located on Enterprise Road, Industrial Area, Nairobi.

## Docs

- [Isuzu Vehicle Showroom](https://www.edwinkibiraisuzusales.co.ke/vehicles/): Complete catalog of brand-new Isuzu vehicles with prices, specifications, and bank asset financing options.
- [Isuzu D-Max Pickups](https://www.edwinkibiraisuzusales.co.ke/vehicles/d-max/): Single Cab, Space Cab, and Double Cab 4x2 and 4x4 pickups (1.9L and 3.0L BluePower).
- [Isuzu Commercial Trucks](https://www.edwinkibiraisuzusales.co.ke/trucks/): N-Series light trucks (NLR, NMR, NQR) and F-Series medium and heavy trucks (FRR 90, FVR, FVZ tippers).
- [Isuzu Passenger Buses](https://www.edwinkibiraisuzusales.co.ke/buses/): 26 to 33-seater commuter matatus, 51-seater school buses, and 67-seater luxury coaches.
- [Isuzu mu-X SUVs](https://www.edwinkibiraisuzusales.co.ke/vehicles/mu-x/): 7-seater luxury family SUVs with Bi-LED headlamps and terrain command 4x4.
- [The Ultimate Isuzu Guide](https://www.edwinkibiraisuzusales.co.ke/ultimate-isuzu-guide/): Comprehensive technical encyclopedia covering Isuzu history, engine specs (4JJ3, 4HK1, 6HK1), and maintenance.
- [Asset Financing Calculator](https://www.edwinkibiraisuzusales.co.ke/loan-calculator/): Up to 100% bank financing calculator with monthly repayment estimates and 48-hour approval terms.
- [Fleet & Corporate Sales](https://www.edwinkibiraisuzusales.co.ke/fleet-sales/): Dedicated fleet solutions, custom bodybuilding, and institutional supply for companies and schools across Kenya.
- [Showroom & Contact](https://www.edwinkibiraisuzusales.co.ke/contact/): Enterprise Road, Industrial Area, Nairobi showroom location, phone (0768 351 483), and WhatsApp consultation.
